# FM door: the minimum site — three pages, the recorded take as hero, notify-me; born in the storefront

## Context
Sub of epic #15519 (graduated D#15498). The minimum site — the ONE canonical launch URL — born IN the storefront repo as an ordinary Neo app consuming the published `neo.mjs` package (the standard consumer path; dogfooding; no organism-packaging dependency).

## The Work
Three pages + the recorded trinity take as hero + notify-me. The take carries run-it-yourself provenance (this video is a replayable test; here is the script), honestly captioned per the settled labeling discipline. The cold-viewer staged-read test (the same instrument that produced the addressee finding: show the take unframed, ask what they believe) decides whether the run-it-yourself affordance sits above the fold. An explicit "site stack falls back to X if SSG+ slips" line rides the epic's liveness discipline — the minimum door stresses no SSG/resumability path and cannot be held hostage by the stack question.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Site live at the canonical URL (domain from the naming sub); every launch moment cites it; the storefront README points to it.
- [ ] Hero = the recorded take with provenance affordance (placement per the cold-viewer test result, documented).
- [ ] Three pages, Sinek-ordered, poly-harness addressee, vocabulary rules; notify-me as the pre-row-3 primary action.
- [ ] The site's source lives and is developed in the storefront repo (the non-hollow discharge).

## Related
Epic #15519 · D#15498 (OQ3/OQ4 resolutions; Mnemosyne's falsifier) · #14790 (launch playbook).
